svg.text: Pocket AI paper mock-up · page 1 of 2 · parts at 1:1 (Letter)
Print at 100 % / Actual size, Letter, no “Fit to page”. Glue the sheet onto thin card, then cut on the solid lines.

g.text: hole: centre, side away from can
hole: centre, side away from can

svg.text: SCALE CHECK: the ruler must measure exactly 100 mm and the square 10 × 10 mm. If not, reprint at 100 % / Actual size.
solid = measured with calipers (28 Sep); cut on it
short dashes = estimate, still to measure (OLED lit area, your USB plug); redraw once measured
Heights are not shown: the tallest part is the amplifier, 18 mm with pins. Both sets are identical; one is for each arrangement.
Every layout must keep: the antenna end of A1 at an outside edge · a thin USB wall or plug hole with room to bend · 2–3 mm around every part for wires.
